name: Clifden Farmhouse B&B

tagline.en: Mary’s warm, old-fashioned Irish welcome, with views over Clifden and the town centre just a short walk away.
tagline.ga: Fáilte chroíúil Éireannach Mary, le radharc thar an gClochán agus lár an bhaile siúlóid ghearr uait.

mapQuery: Clifden Farmhouse B&B, Clifden, Co. Galway

en: Mary welcomes you to Clifden Farmhouse, a family B&B looking out over Clifden, the capital of Connemara.
Guests tell us they love the hot, hearty breakfast, the clean and spacious rooms, and plenty of parking. Mary is always happy to share her tips for the best walks, drives and places to eat.
The town’s shops, pubs and restaurants are a short walk away, and the Sky Road, Connemara National Park and Kylemore Abbey are all close by.
ga: Cuireann Mary fáilte romhat go Clifden Farmhouse, B&B teaghlaigh a bhfuil radharc aige thar an gClochán, príomhbhaile Chonamara.

Deir aíonna linn gur breá leo an bricfeasta te, flaithiúil, na seomraí glana fairsinge, agus neart páirceála. Bíonn Mary i gcónaí sásta a cuid moltaí a roinnt faoi na siúlóidí, na tiomántáin agus na háiteanna is fearr le hithe.
Tá siopaí, tithe tábhairne agus bialanna an bhaile siúlóid ghearr uait, agus tá Bóthar na Spéire, Páirc Náisiúnta Chonamara agus Mainistir na Coille Móire ar fad in aice láimhe.
